result.rationale: In EventManager.ts the diff adds `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then checks `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` without optional chaining. When destinationCalendar is null/empty, the destructured variable is undefined and this throws a TypeError, crashing the Meet-fallback path. The new no-destinationCalendar code (e.g. handleNewBooking sets destinationCalendar to null when neither eventType nor organizer has one) makes this reachable.

judged_text: Destructured mainHostDestinationCalendar is dereferenced without optional chaining, crashing when evt.destinationCalendar is null or empty. const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []; followed by mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration') whenever a Google Meet booking has no destination calendar (e.g. dynamic/round-robin paths where destinationCalendar is null), turning the Meet fallback into a 500 on booking creation.
